levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد

notes: needs_ruling (rule 11): the saying is a scene in which «فقال علي» speaks and acts; not settled whether the Prophet's-story saying belongs to أبيه only or the Imam is a link, so the Imam is not written
«- وكان مؤدباً لبعض ولد جعفر بن محمد -» is a description gloss, left out; «من كتابه وقرأته عليه» is a transmission remark, left out
